name: Translink (South East Queensland GTFS Realtime)
short: Live vehicle positions, trip updates and alerts for South East Queensland public transport; free, keyless GTFS Realtime.
summary: Translink, the Queensland Government public transport authority, publishes GTFS Realtime protobuf feeds for South East Queensland and Cairns: vehicle positions, trip updates and service alerts. The Queensland open data portal lists them under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The feeds answered without a key.

tasks: live position of a bus, train or ferry in South East Queensland

pricing.notes: Open data portal record: licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. No fee or key is mentioned and the feed answered without one.

latency.notes: Live check 2026-11-08: VehiclePositions returned a protobuf feed of about 7.7 kB with current vehicle entities. The update interval is not stated on the portal record.

delivery.basis: Live check 2026-11-08: VehiclePositions returned a protobuf feed of about 7.7 kB with current vehicle entities. The update interval is not stated on the portal record.

coverage.notes: Portal record lists SEQ and Cairns (CNS) feeds. Which operators and modes are included is not stated in the record.

licensing.summary: Open data portal record: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, which allows reuse with attribution. AI training and resale are not mentioned.

auth.how_to_get: No key or registration is needed.

endpoints.notes: GTFS Realtime protobuf of vehicle positions, South East Queensland.

api.notes: Responses are binary protobuf in the GTFS Realtime format, not JSON. A static GTFS feed for the same network is listed on the same portal.

human.unknown: No person is involved in a reading; the data is machine-generated.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation of the data is described.

camera.unknown: Not a camera source; no image signing applies.

time.unknown: Each vehicle entity carries a timestamp from the operator's system; how it is set is not stated.

location.unknown: Positions come from vehicle-reported GPS; nothing independent is described.

content.unknown: No check of a reading against a second source is described.

corroboration.unknown: No independent review of individual records is described.

sources.claim: Record: real-time data in GTFS-RT format, Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, feed URLs
